newsitem.title: USA: U.S. automakers says weak yen hurts domestic sales.
newsitem.headline: U.S. automakers says weak yen hurts domestic sales.

text.p: The U.S. dollar's current strength against the Japanese yen is making it harder for U.S. car manufacturers to compete in the domestic market, the Big Three U.S. automakers and a major union warned in a joint statement on Thursday.
"As new automotive sales figures make clear, the accelerating depreciation of the yen has gone from being a troubling trend to a serious problem," said the statement.
"The yen's continuing fall is translating into more sales for Japanese manufacturers at the expense of U.S. automakers and their American Workers," it added.
